description.zh:
API安全状态。取值： 
- **1**：表示开启。
- **0**：表示关闭。
description.en:
The API security status. Valid values: 
- **1**: enabled.
- **0**: disabled.

description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)查询当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the current WAF instance.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

description.zh: 防护对象加入的防护对象组的名称。
description.en: The name of the protected object group to which the protected object is added.
The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID.
The name of the protected object.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi modify-apisec-status --instance-id waf-cn-tl32ast0000 --resources alb-wewbb23dfset000 --apisec-status 1 --resource-groups group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
